**IT'S SUPERMESSI!** 🦸‍♂️🐐💙

Messi is flying while holding the GIANT METEOR above the Earth! 🤯🔥

And Ronaldo? BRO IS LEFT COMPLETELY SPEECHLESS! 😭💀

Meanwhile, the ball actually reaches her perfectly!

Neymar confidently signs off with:

*“EASY, YAMAL!”* 😎🔥

Yamal watches the clip…

His smile disappears…

He gets angry…

Bro challenged Neymar…

Neymar accepted the challenge…

*NEVER CHALLENGE NEYMAR! 🔥⚽*

**BRO GOT LAUNCHED INTO THE WATER! 😂💀**

**“Cris!”** 😂❤️

Messi flips the bottle…

**MESSI CATCHES IT FIRST!** 😭😂

**MATEO SNATCHES THE BOTTLE!** 😂🔥

In today's video...

**Yamal breaks Ronaldo's heart... but Ronaldo gets his revenge! 😂🐐**

---

It starts with Ronaldo and Yamal at an awards ceremony. 🏆

---

The announcer says:

**"Lamine Yamal — Spain, Barcelona!"**

---

Everyone starts clapping...

Even Ronaldo! ❤️

**"Good job!"** 👏🐐

Yamal walks onto the stage to collect his award. 🏆

---

Then it's time for his speech.

---

Ronaldo starts smiling...

And he's thinking:

*"He's definitely going to say I'm the GOAT."* 😂

---

Yamal gets ready to speak...

---

But then...

**"Messi is the GOAT!"** 🐐

---

---

He quietly walks away...

Trying to hide his disappointment. 😂

---

But Ronaldo doesn't forget.

😈

---

Ronaldo and Georgina are watching a boxing match. 🥊

---

Georgina suddenly says:

**"Look! There's Yamal!"** 👀

---

Ronaldo looks over...

And there Yamal is, sitting with his friends. 😂

---

The boxer starts talking to the crowd.

---

**"Tonight's fight is happening here in Barcelona!"** 🔥

---

Yamal starts laughing.

He's loving it because he's in Barcelona. 😂❤️

---

But then the boxer says:

**"Although... I wish we were in Madrid instead!"** 😭😂

---

Ronaldo starts laughing. 💀

---

And then the boxer drops the final line:

**"RONALDO IS THE GOAT!"** 🐐🔥

---

Ronaldo is loving every second of it. 😂❤️

---

But Yamal...

😐

---

His smile disappears.

---

He just sits there in shock. 😭💀

---

Ronaldo looks over like:

**"Remember what you said?"** 😈😂

---

Yamal: 😳

Ronaldo: 😂🐐

---

**Yamal chose Messi...**

**Ronaldo chose REVENGE.** 💀🔥

---

GOAT debate:

Messi fans: 🐐🇦🇷

Ronaldo fans: 🐐🇵🇹

Yamal: 😭💀

---

**Ronaldo's revenge was personal. 😂🐐🔥**

In today's video...

**Neymar challenges Ronaldo... but Ronaldo has a response ready. 😂🐐**

---

It starts with MrBeast and Ronaldo together.

MrBeast looks at Ronaldo and says:

**"Ronaldo, look at Neymar!"** 👀

---

They look over...

And Neymar says:

**"Yo Ronaldo, look at me!"** 😂

---

Ronaldo immediately realizes what's happening.

**"He's challenging me!"** 😭🔥

---

MrBeast:

*"Yeah!"* 😂

---

Neymar is standing there looking at the camera...

When suddenly, a girl standing far away kicks a ball toward him. ⚽

---

Neymar reacts instantly...

He controls the situation and kicks the ball straight back **in mid-air!** 😱🔥

---

Ronaldo is shocked.

*"Damn... insane!"* 😳

---

But Ronaldo knows one thing...

**He can do better.** 🐐😈

---

The next day, Ronaldo is at a ceremony with Cristiano Jr.

But he's still thinking about Neymar.

---

He keeps asking:

**"Where's Neymar?"**

😂😂

---

And then...

Neymar is there too! 👀

---

Neymar asks his wife:

**"Is Ronaldo here?"**

She says:

*"Yeah."*

---

Neymar looks around...

And Ronaldo is already there. 😭😂

---

They finally meet.

Ronaldo walks straight up to Neymar:

**"You challenged me, didn't you?"** 👀

---

Neymar smiles.

---

Ronaldo:

**"If you want to challenge me... come to the game tomorrow."** 🔥🐐

---

They shake hands...

Then hug. ❤️⚽

---

**Challenge accepted.** 😈

---

The next day...

Ronaldo is training before the match. 🔥

---

He looks at Neymar.

**"Look at me."** 👀

---

Ronaldo gets the ball...

Throws it into the air using his feet...

---

Neymar watches closely.

👏👏👏

---

Ronaldo:

**"Okay... watch this."** 😏

---

He controls the ball...

Catches it between his legs...

And then...

**THROWS IT BEHIND HIS BACK WITHOUT EVEN LOOKING!** 😱🔥

---

Neymar's jaw drops. 😭

---

He can't believe what he just saw.

---

Neymar starts clapping...

Then bows down to Ronaldo. 😂🙏

---

Ronaldo just smiles.

😎🐐

---

Neymar's challenge:

🔥 INSANE

Ronaldo's response:

💀 **EVEN MORE INSANE**

---

**When Neymar challenges Ronaldo... Ronaldo doesn't answer with words.**

**He answers with SKILLS.** 🐐🔥

Cristiano Jr.

Antonela.

Mateo.

**Messi's family or Ronaldo's family?** 👀

Neymar doesn't even think twice. 😂

Not happy at ALL. 😭💀

---

Ronaldo is already thinking...

*"Okay... I'll remember this."* 😭😂

---

Then Neymar gets another choice.

---

**Ronaldo's dad or Messi's dad?** 👀

---

Neymar starts thinking.

---

Ronaldo looks at him...

*"Please... my dad."* 🥹😂

---

Neymar finally chooses Ronaldo's dad.

---

Ronaldo is instantly happy. 😭❤️

---

Respect restored.

For about five seconds. 😂

---

Because then comes the BIGGEST question.

---

**Messi or Ronaldo?** 👀🔥

---

Ronaldo immediately points at himself.

*"Choose me!"* 😂🐐

---

Neymar looks at Ronaldo...

---

Then looks at Messi.

---

And says...

**NOPE.** 😭😂

---

He chooses his best friend...

**MESSI.** ❤️🐐

---

Messi starts smiling. 😂❤️

---

Ronaldo?

Absolutely furious. 😭💀

---

Neymar has now chosen Messi twice...

---

Ronaldo starts thinking...

*"Fine..."* 😈

---

**REVENGE TIME.** 😂

---

The next day...

Neymar and Ronaldo step into the ring. 🥊🔥

---

Round one begins.

---

Neymar tries his best...

---

But Ronaldo comes in with the energy of a man who remembers EVERY answer. 😭😂

---

And of course...

**RONALDO WINS!** 🐐🔥

---

Neymar bows down.

😂🙏

---

*"I'm sorry, Ronaldo!"* 😭😂

---

Ronaldo starts laughing.

---

He finally got his revenge. 😂👑

---

Neymar chose Messi...

Ronaldo chose REVENGE. 😭💀

--

Never make three wrong choices in front of Cristiano Ronaldo. 😂🐐

2026. ⏩

In today's video...

An entire hospital is full of injured footballers. 😭🏥

And the reason behind it...

Is absolutely hilarious. 😂

---

It starts with an old video of Roberto Carlos. 👀

---

He is walking through a hospital. 🏥

---

He looks into the first room.

One of his teammates is lying there injured. 🤕

---

Roberto is confused.

---

He walks to the next room.

Another teammate...

Also injured. 😭

---

Then the next room.

---

Another injured player. 🤕

---

Roberto scratches his head.

---

*"What is happening here?"* 😂

---

He keeps walking...

Until he reaches a vending machine. 🥤

---

He puts in a coin.

---

Presses the Pepsi button.

---

Nothing happens. 😐

---

He presses it again.

Still nothing. 😂

---

Now Roberto gets angry. 😤

---

He starts kicking the machine. 💀

---

One kick...

Two kicks...

Three kicks...

---

Suddenly...

*"AAAH!"* 😭

---

He grabs his leg.

Now he's injured too. 😂

---

That's why everyone in the hospital was hurt. 💀

---

But someone has been watching the whole time...

A young Cristiano Ronaldo. 👦👀

---

He quietly walks over to the vending machine.

---

Looks behind it.

---

Then notices something.

👀

---

The power plug isn't connected. 🔌

---

Ronaldo simply plugs it into the socket.

---

The machine lights up. ✨

---

He presses the Pepsi button.

---

The drink drops perfectly. 🥤

---

Ronaldo picks it up with a smile. 😎

---

Then...

He unplugs the machine again. 😂💀

---

Walks away like nothing happened. 😭

---

200 IQ.

One Pepsi.

And one future GOAT. 🐐😂
